description: Chilean power grid activity, edge and node data is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Seung-Woo Son, Heetae Kim. Edge data of Chilean power grid 'without tap' version. Edge lists are recorded with ID of nodes. It also includes the length, capacity information. Please, see the corresponding node file to see the detail informaion of the nodes. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The repository holds 10 deposits of this kind (versions, parts or per-site or per-year releases); this record describes the series through its most recent member and lists the others in the notes. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 11837 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
